mapper.insert: insert into litemall_cj_product (pid, source, title, price, sell_price, discount_price, description, image_url, brand, category_names, category_ids, variants_json, attributes_json, images_json, detail_html, enriched_time, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{pid}, #{source}, #{title}, #{price}, #{sellPrice}, #{discountPrice}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{brand}, #{categoryNames}, #{categoryIds}, #{variantsJson}, #{attributesJson}, #{imagesJson}, #{detailHtml}, #{enrichedTime}, now(), now(), 0) on duplicate key update source = values(source), title = values(title), price = values(price), sell_price = coalesce(values(sell_price), sell_price), description = values(description), image_url = values(image_url), brand = values(brand), category_names = values(category_names), category_ids = values(category_ids), update_time = now(), deleted = 0
mapper.update: update litemall_cj_product set price = coalesce(#{price}, price), variants_json = #{variantsJson}, attributes_json = #{attributesJson}, discount_price = #{discountPrice}, images_json = #{imagesJson}, detail_html = #{detailHtml}, sell_price = coalesce(#{sellPrice}, sell_price), listed_num = coalesce(#{listedNum}, listed_num), review_count = coalesce(#{reviewCount}, review_count), rating = coalesce(#{rating}, rating), cj_create_time = coalesce(#{cjCreateTime}, cj_create_time), reviews_synced_time = coalesce(#{reviewsSyncedTime}, reviews_synced_time), enriched_time = now(), update_time = now() where pid = #{pid} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select cp.* from litemall_cj_product cp left join litemall_goods g on g.cj_pid = cp.pid and g.deleted = 0 left join ( select goods_id, count(*) as views from litemall_footprint where deleted = 0 and add_time > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by goods_id ) f on f.goods_id = g.id where cp.deleted = 0 order by (cp.enriched_time is null) desc, coalesce(f.views, 0) desc, coalesce(cp.listed_num, 0) desc, cp.enriched_time asc, cp.add_time desc limit #{limit}
